name: Sentara's Clothing, Front Room
desc1: This is a pleasant, brightly lit shop. Paintings line the wall, and
desc2: the furnishings are of the finest quality. There are racks of clothing
desc3: and stands of leather armour here. The Lady Sentara sits behind her
desc4: desk, looking her usual ravishing self, and she smiles as you
desc5: approach. To the east, the shop continues, and you can exit through
desc6: open doors to the south and west.
